# heraut skill install

Write the agent skill to \<dir\>/heraut/SKILL.md.

Write the agent skill to \<dir\>/heraut/SKILL.md, by default under .claude/skills. A file identical to
the bundled one is left alone; a file that differs is replaced only with --force.

## Usage

```text
heraut skill install [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
heraut skill install
heraut skill install --dir ~/.claude/skills
heraut skill install --force
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--dir <string>` | `.claude/skills` | skills directory to install into |
| `--force` |  | replace an installed skill that differs from the bundled one |

## Global flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--config <string>` |  | path to .heraut.yml (default: auto-discover) |
| `--verbose` |  | echo each command and emit diagnostic logs |
